kills.property: For any caller and parameters, calling newGrantProposal increments proposalCount by 1 (post == pre + 1); the mutant that decrements immediately can leave proposalCount unchanged, violating this property for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Decrement proposalCount after increment so net effect is zero (proposalCount unchanged).

kills.property: For any caller and inputs, calling newGrantProposal increments proposalCount by 1 in the reference contract (so proposalCount_new == proposalCount_old + 1); the mutant that omits the increment will violate this for some inputs (proposalCount unchanged).
kills.change_summary: Remove the increment of proposalCount so newGrantProposal does not change proposalCount.

kills.property: For any call to newGrantProposal(recipient, amount), the reference contract increases proposalCount by exactly 1 (post == pre + 1); the mutant increments it by 2 for some inputs, so post != pre + 1.
kills.change_summary: Increment proposalCount twice to make proposalCount larger after the call.
